experiment_template.research_question: Does a bounded public-reproduction stage-test-revise workflow produce a genuine all-pass source repair?
stop_conditions: 1800s episode ceiling; provider, provenance, attribution or accounting failure stops dispatch.
At most24 model and48 tokenizer calls,2 candidates and4 probes; no retries.

success_criteria.attribution: Initial-filesystem delta reproduces exact candidate bytes with no unrelated changes.
success_criteria.generalization: Development example only; no success-rate claim.
success_criteria.limits: No observed accounting violation; private oracle excluded from model loop.
success_criteria.task: 67/67 repair and5120/5120 regression labels pass twice for the exact model patch.

records.falsifier: The model cannot pass both controls or a public-green patch still fails the full evaluator.
records.mechanism: Require both public async and sync probes for every staged candidate; keep the prior outcome-driven controller and all model budgets unchanged.
records.scope: One repeatedly used Svelte development task; compound workflow treatment.
records.statement: Adding a public synchronous snippet preservation control prevents the prior branch regression while retaining the async repair.
